previous_versions.body:
Thanks for your interest :)

At this point, I would strongly suggest waiting a few months as by then we will hopefully have a finalised version 5.0 which you can translate.

If you really want to do a translation of v4.0.3 we have more guidance [here](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#translations) but given I am not sure when exactly we will be able to integrate it as we are working hard on 5.0 right now...
